question.value: What is the abundance of CH3NC in the protostellar binary IRAS 16293-2422 compared with CH3CN, and what do chemical models imply about CH3NC formation and destruction?

evidence.quote: The aims of this work are to determine the abundances of methyl isocyanide in the solar-type protostellar binary IRAS 16293–2422 and understand the stark abundance differences observed between methyl isocyanide and methyl cyanide in the ISM.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.00278.S.
